title: Internal meetings – notify participants
description: For meetings among colleagues. Participants are told that the meeting is recorded and transcribed, and an objection from any of them stops it: Meeting Consent mode Notify, with evidence screenshots kept, streaming clients without a consent step accepted with a warning, and a different choice allowed per meeting. Meeting audio is recorded and the meeting chat is added to the transcript. The other settings this preset sets keep their shipped defaults: transcripts are kept for the retention period, personal information is not redacted, and Amazon Bedrock models run as chosen (Global inference geography). The meeting assistant and summary settings it sets keep their shipped defaults: anyone in the meeting may make a request, answered from the current meeting only with no access to the meeting context and checklist; web search and the installed MCP servers are available; and new meetings start with no summary profile. Every other setting stays as it is.
